name: blockfire-native
description: BLOCKFIRE as an Android and iPhone app: the game in a Capacitor shell (see native/README.md)

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync && cap sync ios
